trajectory_metric: RMS over 882 windows and nine training-standardized state coordinates at step 60, identical to the main-table per-trajectory metric
trajectory_selection: closest to the median of the twelve trajectory metrics
window_metric: L2 norm of nine training-standardized state errors at step 60 divided by sqrt(9)
window_selection: within the selected trajectory, closest to the median of its 882 window metrics
tie_break: distances equal within rtol=1e-12 and atol=1e-15 are ties; choose smallest trajectory ID, then earliest prediction origin
selection_scope: post-hoc illustrative selection only; not selected by comparative performance or visual appearance
comparison: all six predictors use exactly the same selected trajectory, origin, truth and prescribed inputs
not_claimed: This is not a pointwise median curve or a median window for every predictor/state/horizon.
